entities.summary: The Ama Museum is a museum dedicated to comfort women in Taiwan. It opened in 2016, in Datong District, Taipei. The original location closed in November 2020, and the museum was relocated and reopened in April 2021 at 5F., No. 32, Sec. 3, Chengde Rd., Datong Dist., Taipei City, Taiwan (R.O.C.). Ama Museum is a museum in Asia, established in 2016-12-10. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
